component.name: FinAgent
component.summary: Local, privacy-first personal finance categorization and dashboard

description.p: FinAgent is a local-first personal finance categorization and analytics application. It combines deterministic merchant rules, optional business location lookup (OpenStreetMap / Google Places), and local or cloud LLMs (Ollama, Claude, OpenRouter) to turn raw bank statements and receipts into an interactive financial ledger.
All bank statements, configuration, and processed transaction data remain on your local machine.
Multi-architecture Linux & Docker support, Places API combined pipeline, and Overview dashboard improvements.
